Independent rerun also passes reserve-to-claim and settlement-to-repair timing, under-ceiling late delta followed by input/output/proposal capacity refusal, exactly-once committed accounting, pin failure and terminal cancellation without revival. Source guards remain current and a fresh accounting transaction preserves pending deltas after source/pin refusal. Frozen corpus now includes four hostile current-page NEXT_ACTION cases shared by controlled tests and the opt-in provider harness, alongside four source cases. retained_findings.finding: A genuine delayed bootstrap callback from an earlier context with zero allocations can arrive after CONTEXT_PENDING captures one later allocation. Because hadEvidenceBeforeDelivery was false when the marker was written, finishBootstrap accepts that old callback and marks READY without any delivery/acknowledgement of the current allocation metadata. The callback only binds context identity, not materialization revision or allocations.
retained_findings.suggested_action: Bind READY to proof of delivery of the exact pending materialization/allocation snapshot, not to whether callback evidence was already present when CONTEXT_PENDING was written. Persist sufficient context-send provenance or require a successful same-context metadata acknowledgement whenever the callback cannot be tied to that snapshot. Preserve recovery of a lost response for the exact original snapshot, avoid requiring a second bootstrap callback, and never create a new context or dispatch right. Add the real delayed-callback race probe alongside the already-passing prior-callback/lost-response tests.
retained_findings.limits: Reproduces premature READY and missing metadata delivery, not duplicate browser effects or a bypass of the later OBS-004 prepare/admit checks. This retains the original REL-001 readiness/recovery finding under mandatory REL-R1-2/4, rather than adding scope.
